Reviewer C

Comment 1: In your tables you are showing not just an increase in lung resection numbers (281%) but also a 135% increase in the number of cases referred for surgical evaluation and almost 21% increase in the surgical resection rate.Such impressive numbers should be not just a consequence of team improvements but also the circuit of case referrals and decision-making was probably improved in any way.I believe your manuscript would be improved if you briefly describe the population you are covering, lung cancer incidence in your settings and were from you are receiving lung cancer patient for surgical therapy.If your process of change included any kind of agreements or standardisation with external or internal providers of patients, and medical staff in charge of postoperative care, ICU, etc.

Reply 1: Thank you.We have expanded on the description of our referring population.The catchment population has not changed.Clearly the changes introduced from start (appointment and support of experienced Minimally Invasive surgeons) helped that more patients could be offered surgical treatments; and the progressive improvements did follow.We have added further discussion as suggested Changes in Text: Clarified at Discussion section and also in Methods regarding catchment area.

Comment 2: Your reference list should be numbered.Reply 3: Thank you.We have maintained until end of 2023 the national targets for waiting to a satisfactory point, even during the pandemia.Our changes influenced patient recruitment within a fixed catchment population
Changes in text: methods

Comment 4: It would be useful to provide some information about the surgeons in the team and their experience to ensure that this improvement does not also correspond to their learning curve Reply 4: added
Changes in Text: methods
Reviewer F

Comment 1: We would like to know the population background of the author's area, the population of the medical area covered by the author's hospital, how many hospitals there are, and other local statistics.
Reply 1: added
Changes in Text: methods

Comment 2: 1.2 Rationale and knowledge gap: The mention of the pandemic impacting the scarcity of resources needs more elaboration.Specifically, it would help to highlight how the pandemic exacerbated the challenges already faced in addressing lung cancer.I understand it sensibly but would like to see a more detailed description as a medical manuscript Reply 2: added
Changes in Text: methods and results

Comment 3: The section detailing how Kotter's 8-step change model was implemented could benefit from a more thorough breakdown.Including figures or tables to better illustrate each step in the context of the study might enhance clarity.Discuss the methodology used to determine the goals stated, i.e., why specifically a 25% increase in surgical resection rate and a 35% decrease in the use of critical care beds were targeted.
Reply 3: those were aims taking into account national averages, the target of Critical Care beds was probably more aggressive than 35% following the pandemia
Changes in text: expanded in Methods

Comment 4: Results: The results should include more statistical data, like p-values, to establish the significance of the changes observed.Including visual aids such as graphs or charts might also help better to represent the changes over time and their impact.

Reply 4: Thank you.We do not feel that this is a purely statistical manuscript.The general data does not really require statistical analyses, but could be provided if Editor feels necessary Changes in Text: we haven't addressed this issue but would be happy to do so as data is quite clear and general.
Comment 5: Discussion: More in-depth analysis of how the model's flexibility contributed to its success, particularly during unpredictable situations like the pandemic, would be beneficial.
If data is available, incorporate a comparison with other hospitals or regions further to underline the success and significance of the model.
The "Future Challenges" section might benefit from a more detailed discussion on the potential challenges of implementing CT scan screenings on a larger scale.

Reply 5: Thank you.Unfortunately in the UK these data has not been shared/presented by individual units since 2020 is it was felt that the pandemia and its recovery might have impacted units differently.Prior to that there is a yearly report showing a more gradual increase in lung cancer resections nationally than the one we experienced, probably because there were better organised services that ours at the start
Minor Revisions
Comment 6: The formatting seems inconsistent, particularly with section numbering (e.g., "1.Introduction" followed by "1.1 Background").
Reply: thank you

Changes in text: throughout Comment 7: Some sentences could be streamlined for clarity and brevity.For instance, the sentence "Kotter's change model is an 8-step process which is designed to promote effective and sustained change at an organisational level" could be rephrased to "Kotter's 8-step change model promotes sustained organizational change."Reply 1: We will leave that to the Editors' to decide.It is an original manuscript; and we have expanded the data to reinforce this.
